newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian share trade surges as Hanspank active.
newsitem.headline: Estonian share trade surges as Hanspank active.

text.p: Share trade on the Estonian stock market leapt on Thursday as leading bank Hansapank was at the centre of a flurry of activity, dealers said.

It turned over 15 million kroons of stock out of healthy overall official list activity of 24 million kroons. The Tallinn stock exchange index climbed by a further 0.39 percent to 110.0. Hansapank stock ended up at 108.30 kroons, versus 107.95.
"There were two block trades of 50,000 shares each," Tallinna Pank dealer Toomas Tsopp said, explaining the Hansapank activity.

Savings Bank was also well-traded again on volume of four million kroons. It closed higher at 54.30 kroons versus 53. Union Bank was next most traded on business of 3.4 million kroons, closing almost unchanged at 22.30 kroons.
Brewer Saku led business on the over-the-counter market, turning over five million kroons and closing at 40.50 kroons versus 39.75 kroons.
Total free market volume came to 9.6 million kroons.
